SELECT tm.model_id, tm.manufacturer, tm.name, tm.transport_category, tm.upgrade_type, tm.upgrade_location, tm.lap_time, tm.top_speed, tm.price, tm.release_date, tm.source, tm.weight, tm.drive_train, tm.seats, tm.features, COUNT(ot.owned_id) AS owned_count FROM transport_model tm LEFT JOIN owned_transport ot ON ot.model_id = tm.model_id
AND ( tm.manufacturer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR tm.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY tm.model_id
ORDER BY tm.manufacturer ASC
ORDER BY tm.manufacturer DESC
ORDER BY tm.name ASC
ORDER BY tm.name DESC
ORDER BY tm.transport_category ASC
ORDER BY tm.transport_category DESC
ORDER BY tm.lap_time ASC
ORDER BY tm.lap_time DESC
ORDER BY tm.top_speed ASC
ORDER BY tm.top_speed DESC
ORDER BY tm.price ASC
ORDER BY tm.price DESC
ORDER BY tm.release_date ASC
ORDER BY tm.release_date DESC
ORDER BY tm.manufacturer ASC, tm.transport_category ASC, tm.name ASC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transport_model
AND ( manufacturer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT model_id, manufacturer, name, transport_category, upgrade_type, upgrade_location, lap_time, top_speed, price, release_date, source, weight, drive_train, seats, features FROM transport_model ORDER BY manufacturer ASC, name ASC, transport_category ASC
